name: ChatGPT (connected MCP or Work box)

wire.verify: User-reported MCP and Linux Work-box execution. ClientInfo names, attachment paths, preview behavior and limits still require per-surface field verification. No config writer or automatic host detection.

manual: Use connected Mojulo MCP tools when available; get_adapter with id chatgpt selects the card explicitly. In a shell-enabled Work box use a pinned Mojulo CLI with MOJULO_HOST=chatgpt and MOJULO_SURFACE=box; start with orient. Do not run init in the box.
